temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough and that she wonders if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley cared for the patient and may be grieving, but she does not yet know how deeply affected or self-blaming Shirley feels.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley's demeanor and words confirm that she is deeply affected and struggling with possible self-doubt or guilt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving deeply and may be blaming herself, so she needs reassurance and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley, reassure her that they did everything they could, and help her remember the good care they provided.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different treatment approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and may feel some self-doubt, but she has not yet fully confirmed that Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley directly confirms that she feels responsible and burdened by the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is carrying guilt and responsibility and needs help reframing the decisions as team-based choices made with the available information.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathetic concern, sadness, resolve to help
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility, validate their shared decisions, and encourage her not to carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes that Shirley has remained reserved with minimal emotional expression, and during a quiet office moment Shirley admits she holds back feelings because she fears seeming unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is still grieving and burdened by guilt, and that she may be withdrawn, but she does not yet know Shirley is deliberately hiding emotions to appear professional.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley is suppressing her feelings because she fears appearing unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs explicit permission and a safe, friendly space to express emotions, and that emotional openness is healthy rather than a weakness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to be open about her feelings, reassure her that expressing emotion is healthy, and offer friendship and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara brings up her previous confrontation and apologizes; Shirley says it was a bit much but understands Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her earlier confrontation may have been too harsh or pushy, and she is uncertain whether it harmed their friendship, so she wants to repair any damage.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley accepts the apology and affirms that she understands Sara's intent and values continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship is mended or strengthened, Shirley appreciates her support, and open communication should continue with more sensitivity.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Remorse and apology, then relief and warmth
temporal_state_chain.intention: To make amends, remain supportive in whatever way Shirley needs, and continue talking while being more mindful of her approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been gradually improving and that their talks may be helping, but she is not yet certain how much Shirley wants social support outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley confirms she feels better because of Sara's support and is receptive to spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes her support is helping, Shirley is improving, and their friendship can deepen through continued contact outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley, plan a weekend activity together, and maintain their supportive friendship.
